_comment: Facts about the battery that its CSV files do not carry. Read by tools/paper_results.py; the paper takes them through \result{} keys like every other number. Sources: the owner's record of the runs for the commits and the spot check; docs/history.md for the first run of the held-out set.

timing._source: results/load.txt and scripts/bench.sh --timing: base variant, serial, median of the repeats of each run

heldout_first_run._source: docs/history.md, entry '2026-11-11: held-out scenarios', table of first results (base variant, Chrono). Errors as fractions of the reference, transcribed from the percentages and factors of that table.
